An '''Onderonian sarcophagus transport''' was used to transport the sarcophagi of [[Amanoa]], [[Freedon Nadd]], and [[Ommin/Legends|Ommin]] from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] to [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]].
